title: Examining Imbalance Effects on Performance and Demographic Fairness of Clinical Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance metrics (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, AUC) and calculating Equality Differences (ED) for ICD-10 code prediction across five distinct patient age groups (18-29, 30-49, 50-69, 70-89, 90+).

Evaluating disparities in predictive performance metrics and Equality Differences (ED) for ICD-10 code prediction across diverse racial and ethnic categories (White, Black/African American, Hispanic/Latino, Asian).
Measuring variations in clinical language model performance metrics and calculating Equality Differences (ED) between male and female patient cohorts for medical code prediction.

Using patient insurance status (Medicaid, Medicare, Other) as a proxy for Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) to evaluate performance disparities and compute Equality Differences (ED) across socioeconomic groups.
